SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.member_id AS memberId, b.board_type_id AS boardTypeId, b.version, c.id AS categoryId FROM board b JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.id = #{boardId} AND b.state = false

SELECT b.id, b.title, , b.content, b.views, m.member_name AS author, m.id AS memberId, b.board_type_id AS boardTypeId, c.category_name FROM board b JOIN member m ON m.id = b.member_id JOIN category c ON c.id = b.category_id WHERE b.id = #{boardId} AND b.state = false

SELECT b.id, c.category_name, , th.store_name, th.extension, th.path, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file f WHERE f.board_id = b.id AND f.state = false) AS fileCount FROM board b JOIN category c ON c.id = b.category_id JOIN thumbnail th ON th.board_id = b.id WHERE b.board_type_id = #{boardTypeId} AND b.state = false ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT 3
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET title = #{board.title}, content =#{board.content}, category_id = #{board.categoryId}, version = version +1 WHERE id = #{boardId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND state = false AND version = #{board.version}
UPDATE board SET views = views + 1 WHERE id = #{boardId} AND state = false
